## S10: Raw MRI Timing Data (Balanced Dataset) {.appendix}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-time-acq99
#| tbl-cap: "Timing data for all raters on the balanced dataset of 99 raw MRI images. Session = total QC session duration; Rests = number of breaks (>15 min); Pass/Fail N = number of images rated; Pass/Fail Time = median (SD) time per image in mm:ss format; p = Wilcoxon test p-value for Pass vs. Fail time difference; p adj. = Holm-adjusted p-value."

acq_99_time <- read_rds(here("data/derivatives/acq_99_time_dt.rds"))
acq_99_time[Diff > as.difftime(15*60, units = "secs"), Rest := TRUE]
acq_99_time[!is.na(Rest), Diff := NA]

acq_99_summ1 <- acq_99_time[, .(N = .N,
                  Rests = sum(Rest, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Session = hms::as_hms(sum(as.numeric(Diff), na.rm = TRUE)),
                  PvF = suppressWarnings(
                          wilcox.test(as.numeric(Diff) ~ Rating,
                                      na.action = na.omit))$p.value), Rater]

acq_99_all1 <- acq_99_summ1[, .(Rater = "All", N = 99,
                                Rests = round(median(Rests)),
                                Session = hms::as_hms(round(median(as.numeric(Session)))))]
acq_99_all1[, PvF := acq_99_time[, wilcox.test(as.numeric(Diff) ~ Rating,
                                               na.action = na.omit)$p.value]]
acq_99_summ1 <- rbindlist(list(acq_99_summ1, acq_99_all1), use.names = TRUE)

acq_99_summ2 <- acq_99_time[, .(N = .N,
                                Median = hms::as_hms(median(as.numeric(Diff), na.rm = TRUE)),
                                Sd = hms::hms(sd(as.numeric(Diff), na.rm = TRUE))),
                            .(Rater, Rating)] |>
                dcast(Rater ~ Rating, value.var = c("N", "Median", "Sd"))

time_format <- "%02d:%02.0f (%02d:%02.0f)"
acq_99_summ <- acq_99_summ1[acq_99_summ2, on = "Rater",
                            .(Rater, Session, Rests,
                              Pass_N = round(N_Pass),
                              Pass_Time = sprintf(time_format,
                                                  lubridate::minute(Median_Pass),
                                                  lubridate::second(Median_Pass),
                                                  lubridate::minute(Sd_Pass),
                                                  lubridate::second(Sd_Pass)),
                              Fail_N = round(N_Fail),
                              Fail_Time = sprintf(time_format,
                                                  lubridate::minute(Median_Fail),
                                                  lubridate::second(Median_Fail),
                                                  lubridate::minute(Sd_Fail),
                                                  lubridate::second(Sd_Fail)),
                              p = round(PvF, digits = 3))]

# Holm correction
acq_99_p <- acq_99_summ[, .(Rater, p)]
acq_99_p[, p_adj := p.adjust(p, method = "holm")]
acq_99_summ[, p_adj := round(acq_99_p$p_adj, 3)]

acq_99_summ |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    Rater = "Rater", Session = "Total Time", Rests = "Rests",
    Pass_N = "N", Pass_Time = "Time Median (SD)",
    Fail_N = "N", Fail_Time = "Time Median (SD)",
    p = "p", p_adj = "p adj."
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Pass", columns = c(Pass_N, Pass_Time)) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Fail", columns = c(Fail_N, Fail_Time)) |>
  style_manuscript_table(table_type = "supplementary")
```

## S11: Raw MRI Timing Data (ADNI) {.appendix}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-time-acq-adni
#| tbl-cap: "Timing data for all raters on the ADNI raw MRI dataset of 10,196 images. Session = total QC session duration; Rests = number of breaks; Pass/Warning/Fail columns show N (%) and median (SD) time per image in mm:ss format."

acquis_time <- read_rds(here("data/derivatives/acquis_time_dt.rds"))
acquis_time[, Rater := stringr::str_replace(Rater, "0", "-")]
acquis_time[Diff > as.difftime(15*60, units = "secs"), Rest := TRUE]
acquis_time[!is.na(Rest), Diff := NA]

acquis_summ1 <- acquis_time[, .(N = .N,
                  Rests = sum(Rest, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Session = hms::as_hms(sum(as.numeric(Diff), na.rm = TRUE)),
                  PvWvF = suppressWarnings(
                            kruskal.test(as.numeric(Diff) ~ Rating,
                                         na.action = na.omit))$p.value), Rater]

acquis_all1 <- acquis_summ1[, .(Rater = "All", N = sum(N),
                                Rests = round(median(Rests)),
                                Session = hms::as_hms(round(median(as.numeric(Session)))))]
acquis_all1[, PvWvF := acquis_time[, kruskal.test(as.numeric(Diff) ~ Rating,
                                                  na.action = na.omit)$p.value]]
acquis_summ1 <- rbindlist(list(acquis_summ1[order(Rater)], acquis_all1), use.names = TRUE)

acquis_summ2 <- acquis_time[, .(N = .N,
                                Median = hms::as_hms(median(as.numeric(Diff), na.rm = TRUE)),
                                Sd = hms::hms(sd(as.numeric(Diff), na.rm = TRUE))),
                            .(Rater, Rating)] |>
                dcast(Rater ~ Rating, value.var = c("N", "Median", "Sd"))

acquis_summ <- acquis_summ1[acquis_summ2, on = "Rater",
                            .(Rater, Session, Rests,
                              Pass = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", N_Pass, N_Pass / N * 100),
                              Pass_Time = sprintf(time_format,
                                                  lubridate::minute(Median_Pass),
                                                  lubridate::second(Median_Pass),
                                                  lubridate::minute(Sd_Pass),
                                                  lubridate::second(Sd_Pass)),
                              Fail = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", N_Fail, N_Fail / N * 100),
                              Fail_Time = sprintf(time_format,
                                                  lubridate::minute(Median_Fail),
                                                  lubridate::second(Median_Fail),
                                                  lubridate::minute(Sd_Fail),
                                                  lubridate::second(Sd_Fail)),
                              p = sprintf("%04.3f", PvWvF))]

acquis_summ |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    Rater = "Rater", Session = "Total Time", Rests = "Rests",
    Pass = "N (%)", Pass_Time = "Time Median (SD)",
    Fail = "N (%)", Fail_Time = "Time Median (SD)",
    p = "p"
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Pass", columns = c(Pass, Pass_Time), id = "spanner_pass") |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Fail", columns = c(Fail, Fail_Time), id = "spanner_fail") |>
  style_manuscript_table(table_type = "supplementary")
```

## S12: ADNI Post-hoc Analysis {.appendix}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-posthoc-adni
#| tbl-cap: "Dunn's test results comparing timing differences between Pass, Warning, and Fail ratings on the ADNI raw MRI dataset. P-values adjusted using Holm's method."

acquis_posthoc <- acquis_time[, dunn.test::dunn.test(as.numeric(Diff), Rating,
                                                     method = "holm", table = FALSE,
                                                     list = FALSE, kw = FALSE)]
acquis_posthoc_dt <- data.table(
  Comparison = acquis_posthoc$comparisons,
  Z = round(acquis_posthoc$Z, 3),
  P = sprintf("%.4f", acquis_posthoc$P),
  P.adjusted = sprintf("%.4f", acquis_posthoc$P.adjusted)
)

acquis_posthoc_dt |>
  gt() |>
  style_manuscript_table(table_type = "supplementary")
```

## S15: Pre/Post Meeting Agreement Changes {.appendix}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-prepost
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of QC label changes before and after the mid-task protocol clarification meeting for the linear registration task. The table shows the number of images that changed QC label after the meeting for each rater."

# Compare pre-meeting and final ratings
reg_pre_final <- reg_pre[regis[, .(Image, Final = Rating, Rater)],
                         on = .(Image, Rater), nomatch = 0]
reg_pre_final[, Changed := Rating != Final]

reg_meeting <- reg_pre_final[, .(
  N_Rated_Pre = .N,
  N_Changed = sum(Changed),
  Pct_Changed = sprintf("%.1f%%", sum(Changed) / .N * 100),
  Pass_to_Fail = sum(Rating == "Pass" & Final == "Fail"),
  Fail_to_Pass = sum(Rating == "Fail" & Final == "Pass")
), Rater]

reg_meeting_all <- reg_pre_final[, .(
  Rater = "All",
  N_Rated_Pre = .N,
  N_Changed = sum(Changed),
  Pct_Changed = sprintf("%.1f%%", sum(Changed) / .N * 100),
  Pass_to_Fail = sum(Rating == "Pass" & Final == "Fail"),
  Fail_to_Pass = sum(Rating == "Fail" & Final == "Pass")
)]

rbindlist(list(reg_meeting, reg_meeting_all)) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    Rater = "Rater", N_Rated_Pre = "N Rated Pre-meeting",
    N_Changed = "N Changed", Pct_Changed = "% Changed",
    Pass_to_Fail = "Pass to Fail", Fail_to_Pass = "Fail to Pass"
  ) |>
  style_manuscript_table(table_type = "supplementary")
```

## S17: Skull Segmentation Timing Data {.appendix}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-time-seg
#| tbl-cap: "Timing data for both experts on the skull segmentation dataset."

rskull_time <- copy(rskull)
rskull_time[, Diff := as.numeric(Diff)]
rskull_time[Diff > 15*60 | Diff < 0, Rest := TRUE]
rskull_time[!is.na(Rest), Diff := NA]

rskull_summ1 <- rskull_time[, .(N = .N,
                  Rests = sum(Rest, na.rm = TRUE),
                  Session = hms::as_hms(sum(Diff, na.rm = TRUE)),

                          wilcox.test(Diff ~ Rating,
                                      na.action = na.omit))$p.value), Rater]

                                Mean = round(mean(Diff, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                                Sd = round(sd(Diff, na.rm = TRUE), 1)),

                dcast(Rater ~ Rating, value.var = c("N", "Mean", "Sd"))

                            .(Rater, Session, Rests,

                              Fail_N = N_Fail,

                              p = sprintf("%04.3f", PvF))]

rskull_summ |>
  gt() |>

    Rater = "Rater", Session = "Total Time", Rests = "Rests",
```
